account.signUpIntro: With an account you can follow your orders later and manage your details.
account.forgotIntro: Enter your e-mail address. If an account belongs to it, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
account.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A few words in a row are long enough and easy to remember.

account.signUpCheckInbox: We have sent an e-mail to the address you entered. Click the link in that e-mail to use your account. No e-mail? Check your junk mail too.

account.signInFailed: The e-mail address or the password is not right.
account.signInNotVerified: Confirm your e-mail address first. We have sent you a new link.
account.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
account.resetLinkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
account.resetDoneBody: You have been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
account.verifyInvalidBody: The link has expired or was already used. Sign in with your e-mail address and password: we will then send you a new link.
